Hi Laura — thanks for the heads up and the spreadsheet. Short answer: you’ll see a pro-rated charge for the 4 added seats for the remainder of the billing period, and a separate line on your Aug invoice summarizing the mid-cycle adjustment.

Details so you have everything for procurement:
- Monthly list price per seat on your plan: $75.00/seat.
- Previous seat count: 10 -> new seat count: 14 as of 2026-08-03 08:02 UTC (we use the API timestamp).
- Pro-rated days remaining in August (inclusive): 29/31.
- Additional full-month liability for 4 seats would be $300/month; pro-rated charge for Aug = $300 * (29/31) = $280.65 (USD) — charged on your normal billing date.

VAT: thanks for including your VAT ID (ESB12345678). Monica from Finance is cc’d and will validate the VAT ID. For EU B2B with a valid VAT ID we apply reverse-charge (0% VAT) on the invoice; if we can’t validate the ID we must apply country VAT at the local rate.

Monica will follow up with the invoice reference and attach the draft credit/charge lines.

Best,
